name: Antigua and Barbuda

findings.local_actor: APUA iNet (Antigua Public Utilities Authority telecom arm); Government of Antigua and Barbuda
findings.reversal_of: Proposed US$40m, 2%, 20-year Huawei-facilitated loan to upgrade APUA iNet's handset retail component
findings.summary: Prime Minister Gaston Browne said the government declined a US$40m low-interest Huawei loan for APUA iNet's handset retail business out of caution over US-China tensions, despite calling the terms the market's best.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 1 because the offer appears never to have been signed; reversal of a proposal. Coded geopolitical as the PM cited US-China tensions, one week after Pompeo's Jamaica warning. The PM said the deal had no telecoms-network component, so layer 'networks' is approximate (handsets/retail of the state telco); reviewer should judge whether it should move the map. US$40m is the announced loan size.

findings.local_actor: Ministry of Information, Communication Technologies (Minister Melford Nicholas)
findings.summary: In the 2025 budget the government said it would fit out a new Tier-4, EN 50600 government data centre, in an already-built undisclosed building, replacing the one under Parliament, citing AI and storage demand.
findings.analyst_inference: Domestic owner-operator (government). Tier 4 on the basis that the building exists, but fit-out and commissioning were not confirmed; could be argued as tier 2. Vendor, builder and financier not named.

findings.local_actor: Royal Police Force of Antigua and Barbuda; Government of Antigua and Barbuda
findings.summary: Government is rolling out an island-wide public CCTV network of over 200 high-definition cameras for real-time police monitoring at 43-plus traffic, commercial and tourist sites; equipment was shipped by March 2026 and installation began by late May.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: neither article names the camera vendor, donor or financier, and no AI or facial-recognition capability is mentioned. Not corroborated: both sources are one S3 publisher, no S1/S2. Tier 4 as installation had begun; completion not confirmed.

silicon.null_reason: no accelerator purchases or deployments surfaced in any of the searches; no dedicated search spent given small-state budget

models.null_reason: one search on government AI partnerships found only general AI-ethics discussion and diplomatic advocacy; no frontier-model or sovereign-model adoption found

power.null_reason: no AI- or data-centre-specific power evidence surfaced in other searches

research_gaps: Who supplies the RAN and core of APUA, Flow (Liberty Latin America) and Digicel in Antigua? Digicel's 2017 ZTE Uni-RAN deal covered its 26 Caribbean/Central American markets but did not name Antigua; APUA's 2021 FTTH and subsea upgrades named no vendor.
Vendor, donor and financier of the 2026 island-wide CCTV system (over 200 cameras); does it have analytics or facial recognition?

PRC-funded customs/port inspection equipment (China MOFCOM grant, about US$5-6m, handed over December 2019, per AidData) - not coded as it is X-ray/inspection hardware rather than an AI-stack layer; reviewer to decide.
Vendor and builder of the new Tier-4 government data centre, and whether it is commissioned.
